verdicts.reason: A keeps the original order: product circle on the left, then a headline, subhead and CTA stack that shares one left edge. Its flaws are small: the headline nearly touches the right edge and the large circle crowds the top and bottom margins. B breaks the grouping. The headline is alone on the left with nothing under it, the 'Try It' button runs into the bottom of the product circle, and 'Out now.' is pushed out to the side of the button with no connection to the headline. That leaves an empty left-bottom area and a crowded right cluster.
